messages:
maya-docs: FYI opened a small PR to correct the Go SDK example for APAC residency and to add a short note about SG egress. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1033

tomo-sdk: thanks. Which Go example? I remember there was an old curl-to-Go translation that used header `X-Region` incorrectly.

maya-docs: exactly. current Go sample shows: `req.Header.Set("Region", "sg")` which is wrong. Our client exposes SetRegion("sg", ResidencyStrict) now.

rachel-legal: legal phrasing for the footnote please use this exact sentence: "When Data Residency is enabled, we route processing to regional hosts in accordance with our Data Processing Addendum." Do not say "no outbound transfers."

kai-ux: UX nit: put the residency callout above the example, not buried below. Readers often skip to the code.

tomo-sdk: pushing a suggested patch to replace the snippet with this Go code:

```go
// preferred Go SDK usage
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
client.SetRegion("sg", redwood.ResidencyStrict)
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, "Summarize this")
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

Also adding a curl example using the canonical header: `-H "X-Redwood-Region: sg"` and a short migration note: "Deprecated header `X-Region` is supported during a transition period; migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` or SDK helpers."

maya-docs: added Rachel's exact legal sentence in the footnote, moved callout above code, and added Kai's UX placement.

ci-bot: docs-lint failed: MD022 duplicate heading at residency-apac.md lines 12 and 18. linkcheck passed.

maya-docs: fixing duplicate heading now, will squash.

ci-bot: docs-lint passed. doc-bot: PR #1033 by maya-docs  docs/regions/residency-apac.md updated (2 files changed).

doc-bot: Ready to merge after 1 more approval from docs.
